extracted.name: Beef Enchilada Soup
extracted.description: Delicious, nutritious, and easy, this beef enchilada soup can cook in the slow cooker all day or on the stove in just a few minutes. Serve it with shredded cheese, sliced flour tortillas, and sour cream!
ingredient_lines: 4 pounds ground beef, cooked and drained
instruction_lines: Combine ground beef, tomatoes, broth, kidney beans, black beans, enchilada sauce, corn, chilies, and taco seasoning in a slow cooker; mix well.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or High for 4 hours.
